extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology. Automated host-immune/nucleic-acid placeholder claims were removed; mechanism is bounded to membrane interaction/permeabilization evidence supported by this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P32 and P36 directly permeabilize microbial membrane mimics in calcein-loaded POPE/POPG LUVs, with stronger leakage for P36 at matched MIC multiples.
mechanism_claims.limitations: LUV data are membrane-mimic evidence; they support membrane disruption but not a unique molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P36 disrupts P. aeruginosa outer and inner membrane permeability in cell assays, supported by NPN and PI uptake increases at 1x and 2x MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Permeability assays show membrane compromise, not intracellular target binding.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P36 binds bacterial membrane surfaces and membrane components, with LPS interaction, zeta-potential neutralization, live-cell CD/NMR changes, FESEM morphology changes, and SDS/DPC MD simulations supporting a membranolytic mode.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MD and spectroscopy are supporting mechanistic context; the final ontology should not promote immune modulation or nucleic-acid interaction as primary claims for this paper.
